```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- stats::setNames(
    lapply(
      c("lt", "recurrence", "depth"),
      function(key) readCaption(sprintf("tbl.SSM.XAF.%s", key))
    ),
    c("lt", "recurrence", "depth")
  )
}
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssm-xaf-lt
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP$lt

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  `Set` = c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L, 5L),
  `ID` = c("sourceModel", "mmax_waf", "bval_waf", "naf_b", "naf_m"),
  `Type` = c("Source model selection", "maxMagGRRelative", "bGRRelative", "bGRRelative", "maxMagGRRelative"),
  `Applies to` = c("All sources", "MPS-1 to MPS-6", "MPS-1 to MPS-6", "SC_1 to SC_54", "SC_1 to SC_54"),
  `Branches (perturbation, weight)` = c(
    "naf_faults (-, 0.50); naf_smooth (-, 0.50)",
    "+0.2 (0.25); 0.0 (0.50); -0.2 (0.25)",
    "+0.05 (0.25); 0.0 (0.50); -0.05 (0.25)",
    "+0.05 (0.25); 0.0 (0.50); -0.05 (0.25)",
    "+0.2 (0.25); 0.0 (0.50); -0.2 (0.25)"
  )
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL
```

&nbsp;

```{r}
#| label: tbl-ssm-xaf-recurrence
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP$recurrence

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  Group = c("Simple fault", "MPS/SC", "BG"),
  MFD   = c("incrementalMFD", "truncGutenbergRichterMFD", "arbitraryMFD"),
  a     = c("-", "3.13–5.45", "-"),
  b     = c("-", "0.93–1.16", "-"),
  Mmin  = c("6.05", "4.0–4.5", "-"),
  Mmax  = c("6.05–7.75", "5.25–9.00", "5.25–9.00"),
  N     = c(115L, 86L, 54L)
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  .mathHeader(c(a = "a", b = "b", Mmin = "M_{min}", Mmax = "M_{max}", N = "N")) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL <- flextable::align(TBL, j = "N", align = "right", part = "body")
TBL
```

#| label: tbl-ssm-xaf-depth

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  `Source type` = c("Simple fault", "Multi-point (WAF)", "Multi-point (SSA)"),
  `z_upper (km)` = c("0.0", "0.0", "0.0"),
  `z_lower (km)` = c("1.7–25.0", "45.0", "40.0"),
  `Hypocentral depth` = c(
    "From fault geometry",
    "5 km (0.267); 15 km (0.267); 25 km (0.333); 35 km (0.133)",
    "Discrete distribution; mean 18.0–19.5 km"
  )
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
  library = "flextable",
  align.body = "center",
  font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
  font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
TBL
